mapper.select: SELECT year_month, revenue, gross_profit, net_profit FROM biz_financial_monthly WHERE year_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY year_month

SELECT year_month, revenue, cost, gross_profit, operating_expense, net_profit, total_assets, total_liabilities, cash_flow FROM biz_financial_monthly WHERE year_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY year_month
SELECT total_assets, total_liabilities, cash_flow, accounts_receivable, accounts_payable, inventory_value FROM biz_financial_monthly ORDER BY year_month DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT year_month, cost, operating_expense, (cost / NULLIF(revenue, 0)) * 100 as costRatio, (operating_expense / NULLIF(revenue, 0)) * 100 as expenseRatio FROM biz_financial_monthly WHERE year_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY year_month
